answer: Make every new identity carry a physical-cost proof of distinct capacity. Each agent must periodically answer a randomized audit by returning a mirror of a fresh data shard, re-encoded with its own key and stored on separate disks; auditors check ferrous-grade timing limits, like seek latency on basalt-cold archival drives. One operator faking a hundred identities must buy a hundred real storage footprints, so cloning loses money.
